{"script":"rm -rf temp_check && mkdir -p temp_check
find /working -type f -print > temp_check/all_files.txt 2>/dev/null
grep -E '/workspace$' temp_check/all_files.txt > temp_check/matches.txt || true
: > temp_check/confirmed.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p" >> temp_check/confirmed.txt
done < temp_check/matches.txt
if [ -s temp_check/confirmed.txt ]; then echo yes > temp_check/has_workspace; else echo no > temp_check/has_workspace; fi
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" > temp_check/check_time
printf "has_workspace: %s\n\n" "$(cat temp_check/has_workspace)" > temp_check/summary.txt
if [ -s temp_check/confirmed.txt ]; then
  echo "confirmed paths:" >> temp_check/summary.txt
  sed 's/^/ - /' temp_check/confirmed.txt >> temp_check/summary.txt
else
  echo "confirmed paths: none" >> temp_check/summary.txt
fi
touch temp_check/ready
if [ -s temp_check/confirmed.txt ]; then printf 'yes'; else printf 'no'; fi
"}
